title: About
text:
This project analyzes the results of the 2022 Florida General Election using R, tidyverse, and Quarto.



Florida election return data provided by the Florida Division of Elections.
County boundary shape data via the R maps and sf packages.




Created by Nicholas Tison as part of data science coursework based on Preceptor’s Primer for Bayesian Data Science.

title: Florida 2022 General Election Analysis
text:
Welcome to the Florida 2022 General Election Analysis project!
This website explores county-level election outcomes across Florida from the November 8, 2022 general election, featuring interactive maps and data breakdowns.

Key Pages

County Analysis: Explore interactive county maps showing candidate victory margins and vote shares for the gubernatorial election.
About: Background on the project and data sources.

title: 2022 Florida Gubernatorial Election Results
text:
This analysis provides an interactive visualization of county-level returns from the 2022 Florida Gubernatorial Election between Ron DeSantis (REP) and Charlie Crist (DEM).

library(leaflet)
library(sf)
library(maps)
library(scales)

title: 2022 Florida Gubernatorial Election Results
text:
Interactive Election Map
Zoom and hover over any county to inspect county names, vote totals, candidate shares, and victory margins.


Code
# Convert Florida county boundaries to an sf object
fl_sf <- st_as_sf(maps::map("county", "florida", plot = FALSE, fill = TRUE)) |>
  st_transform(4326) |>
  mutate(
    subregion = str_remove(ID, "^florida,"),
    county_clean = str_remove_all(subregion, "[. ]")
  ) |>
  left_join(gov_results, by = "county_clean")

# Symmetrical diverging color palette (Blue = Crist, Red = DeSantis)
max_margin <- max(abs(fl_sf$rep_margin), na.rm = TRUE)
pal <- colorNumeric(
  palette = c("#2166ac", "#f7f7f7", "#b2182b"),
  domain = c(-max_margin, max_margin)
)

# Tooltip labels for hover
labels <- sprintf(
  "<strong>%s County</strong><br/>
   Winner: <b>%s</b><br/>
   DeSantis (REP): %s (%.1f%%)<br/>
   Crist (DEM): %s (%.1f%%)<br/>
   Margin: %+.1f%%",
  fl_sf$county,
  fl_sf$winner,
  comma(fl_sf$REP),
  fl_sf$rep_pct,
  comma(fl_sf$DEM),
  fl_sf$dem_pct,
  fl_sf$rep_margin
) |> lapply(htmltools::HTML)

# Build interactive Leaflet map
leaflet(fl_sf, width = "100%", height = "600px") |>
  addProviderTiles(providers$CartoDB.Positron) |>
  addPolygons(
    fillColor = ~pal(rep_margin),
    weight = 1.2,
    opacity = 1,
    color = "white",
    fillOpacity = 0.8,
    highlightOptions = highlightOptions(
      weight = 3,
      color = "#333",
      fillOpacity = 0.95,
      bringToFront = TRUE
    ),
    label = labels,
    labelOptions = labelOptions(
      style = list("font-weight" = "normal", padding = "4px 8px"),
      textsize = "13px",
      direction = "auto"
    )
  ) |>
  addLegend(
    pal = pal,
    values = c(-max_margin, max_margin),
    opacity = 0.8,
    title = "DeSantis Margin (%)",
    position = "bottomright"
  )
